items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to hip injury; McVay says not making great progress and team being cautious (not long-term).
items.why: Second consecutive DNP; McVay candid on lack of progress
items.implication: Likely miss Week 3 vs DEN; treat as OUT for fantasy
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Davante Adams (142 routes, 42% tgt share without Nacua)

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstring; Grade 1 strain history
items.implication: Expected to miss Week 3 vs IND; Week 4 return possible but not locked
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz saw 30% route targets and team-high 28% target share last week without Collins

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) not practicing; first hurt Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated after 5-150-1 first half Week 1, hasn't practiced full since; Ravens travel to Brazil.
items.why: No full practice since aggravation; second straight DNP confirmed by Schefter/Hensley
items.implication: Likely miss second straight game in Brazil vs DAL
items.opportunity: Upside to Bateman/Andrews/Likely in Ravens passing game

items.text: Tyson Bagent officially DNP first practice of week; all signs point to Case Keenum starting for Bears.
items.why: Bagent DNP; Keenum lean with Williams hurt
items.implication: Keenum likely start; dampens CHI pass catchers (Odunze etc.)
items.opportunity: Lower efficiency/volume for WRs/TEs behind backup

items.text: After good MRI results, Saquon Barkley (stinger) is on the practice field suited up and expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.why: Good MRI + on field + expects to play
items.implication: Full go for MNF; no major role reduction expected
items.opportunity: Maintains RB1 workload; reverse any handcuff panic

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected to land on IR (only 5 games across 3 seasons); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 utilization), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.why: IR placement expected after limited play
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back for CAR

items.text: LOVE Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins; IND 4th-most yds to TEs).
items.why: Target volume + soft defenses; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT
items.implication: Olave WR2/3 smash; Schultz TE1 upside
items.opportunity: Olave air yards/target monopoly; Schultz route targets without Collins

items.text: TNF spots: Has Marshawn Lloyd totally blown chance and ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Is Penix healthy enough to revive Drake London and Kyle Pitts? Does Jayden Reed absence lead to more 2-TE sets? Can Packers OL hold for Christian Watson?
items.why: Role/usage questions on TNF slate with injury absences
items.implication: Monitor Lloyd cede (downgrade); London/Pitts boost if Penix good; Watson/2TE upside sans Reed
items.opportunity: Backfield split change; Penix-London/Pitts chemistry (London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 ypg career w/ Penix per Berry); more TE snaps

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results without Puka: 5-35-3 vs JAX 2025; 8-195-2 vs NYG Monday.
items.why: High route/target share and production in Nacua absences
items.implication: Adams locked WR1 if Nacua OUT Week 3
items.opportunity: 42% target share on 142 routes; clear alpha without Nacua

items.text: Jaxson Dart expected to have knee surgery (ACL intact) ending 2026 season; Harbaugh confirms surgery, out foreseeable future (possible playoffs door if miracles).
items.implication: Giants QB situation open; impacts all NYG pass catchers long-term
items.opportunity: Potential new QB acquisition rumors (Flacco denied interest)

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite prop + soft run defense matchup in Brazil
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs weak DAL front

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86); PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.

HATE Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara active; RB37 util) and Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs 55 yds/3.2 ypc).
items.opportunity: Etienne committee dilution; Stevenson post-fumble demotion + Henderson rise

items.text: HATE Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total 17) and Rome Odunze vs PHI (12% tgt share, 19.6 aDOT, Quinyon Mitchell coverage, low team total).
items.why: Tough defenses + low volume/team totals (Daniels injury context for McLaurin)
